newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SNB keeps discount rate steady at 1.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: SNB keeps discount rate steady at 1.5 pct.

text.p: The Swiss National Bank (SNB) said it made no monetary policy changes after its weekly board meeting.
"No change," said an SNB spokesman in response to an enquiry after today's meeting.
The discount rate remains at 1.50 percent.

Some traders and money market analysts had seen an outside chance for an interest rate cut on Thursday, after news earlier this week that the Swiss gross domestic product fell by 0.9 percent in the second quarter versus the first.
Money market rates were also low on Thursday morning, quoted at times below the 1.50 percent discount rate.
But money market traders attributed the softness mainly to technical factors linked to the end of the latest bank liquidity period. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
